descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 30 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
# Built for people who love board games, All On Board! brings game nights back to life.

The laughter, the rivalry, the quiet focus before a decisive roll: it’s all here in VR/MR. Gather around a virtual table that feels real, no matter how far apart you are.
 
[media]

All On Board! is a platform that lets you enjoy digital versions of the tabletop games you love. The library includes free classics and renowned licensed titles sold separately as DLC (DLC purchase is required only to host; **you can join any game with just the base app**).

# Virus! now available for FREE!
Virus! has arrived, and it joins the platform as a **free game for every All On Board! player**. Collect your organs, keep them safe from infection, and use your cards to mess with your opponents along the way.

[media]

- **Lifelike VR/MR tabletop experience** with realistic physics and intuitive controls
- **Only the host buys the licensed title**; others join with the base app
- **Growing library** of licensed favorites and free classics
- **Cross-platform** and multi-language support
- **Solo**, **co-op**, or competitive sessions
- **Learning Hub in every game** to help you learn fast
- **Save and resume** anytime

[media]

Find other players in our Discord or Telegram and start a session (no AI opponents).

All On Board! is made by an independent studio that loves board games as much as you do. It’s built on passion, constant updates, and a growing lineup of great titles.
[media]
